name: Dragon Tree
hook: Brown leaf tips? Your tap water may be the cause.

steps.title: Bright, indirect light
steps.tip: An east or west window, or a south one with a sheer curtain. Summer sun scorches it. It handles lower light.

steps.title: Water when top 5 cm is dry
steps.tip: Then water well. Use rainwater or filtered water, since fluoride in tap water browns the leaf tips.

steps.title: Warm, away from drafts
steps.tip: It grows best at 18–30°C. Keep it away from cold drafts and hot radiators.

steps.title: Feed April to October
steps.tip: Use a general liquid houseplant fertilizer in the growing season. Too much burns and yellows the leaf tips.

steps.title: Cut back to branch it
steps.tip: Cut a long, bare stem at the height you want. New shoots sprout just below the cut.

steps.title: Check for mites and scale
steps.tip: Check often for spider mites, mealybugs and scale insects, the sap-sucking pests it attracts.

outro: Bright light, filtered water and dry topsoil: neat tips for years.
